name: The Secrets Of That Fool President
original_name: The Secrets Of That Fool President
overview: Ana Valdez and Ricardo Rivera had it all planned out: to betray, crush, and erase Sebastián Castillo in order to seize his empire. When Mariana Vargas discovers that he was her savior, the game changes. At an explosive engagement party, the truth comes out, the balance of power shifts, and a fierce war for Valle Dorado begins.
